_authority: This file is the authority on the sign-off floor. The probes read these numbers; the guide points here rather than restating them. Change a threshold here and the probes follow.
_note: The floor is a floor, not a target. Passing it is the minimum for shipping, not evidence the screen is good.

text_size.applies_to: every rendered text node, anywhere in the document — including the footer, corner tags, the landing screen and inside SVG
text_size.svg_rule: effective px = declared font-size x (rendered width / viewBox width). Never the declared value.

contrast.note: Measure after the settle, not before — see traps.json#transition-settle.

exemptions: an inline link inside a sentence of prose
a visually hidden input behind a label that is itself above the minimum
an element in a hidden overlay, which measures 0 and is not a defect

layout.spill: none — no element may escape its slide body
layout.document_h_scroll: none — documentElement.scrollWidth must not exceed innerWidth
layout.wide_content: a wide table, diagram or code block scrolls inside its own overflow-x container; the page body never scrolls sideways
layout.collision: no element may overlap the header band or another element; run the collision probe as well as the fill probe — see traps.json#flex-centred-overflow

fill.note: Fill above 100 % is overflow even when the spill probe is silent, because a flex-centred body pushes it upward rather than off the bottom.

console.note: Read the console on every page after any scripted edit to inline JavaScript. See traps.json#console-after-scripted-edit.

viewports.why: the classroom projector and the common laptop
the primary device: an Android tablet in portrait
a phone — not a delivery device, but the geometry floor

structural._links_inside_slide_note: Zero, with ONE ruled exception: the hand-off screen's <button> to the next module. A button, not an <a href>; it opens the next instructor deck, never a trainee page; it records nothing.
structural._check_screen_is_last_note: Was true until 2026-09-03. The owner then asked for a hand-off screen AFTER the module check, so Next cannot skip a room into the next module by accident. The check is now second-to-last and the hand-off is last. A checker still asserting the old rule reports a false defect on every deck — it did, on seven of eight.
structural._check_screen_forbidden_words_note: Match on the SCREEN FACE only, and expect two false positives seen in a real sweep: 'check and zero' is a maritime procedure, so the word 'record' inside it is part of that procedure rather than score-recording; and Module 2's check is an observation checklist by design, so it will not look like the others.
